nodes.label: Orange Terracotta Texture
nodes.description: Minecraft-style orange terracotta (hardened clay) texture. Rich warm orange-burnt sienna solid color surface with very subtle pixel variation suggesting fired clay. Matte, earthy appearance with no strong patterning. Color palette: vivid orange (#C86020), burnt orange (#B85010), warm terracotta (#D07030). Game purpose: decorative building block dyed in orange; found naturally in mesa/badlands biomes and crafted by dyeing hardened clay; popular for warm-toned builds.
nodes.pattern: nearly uniform warm orange surface with faint pixel-level clay texture
